summary: Pono Capital Four, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and share rights starting May 5, 2026. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one right to receive one-fifth of one share upon closing of an initial business combination. Separate components will trade on Nasdaq under PONO and PONOR, while units continue as PONOU. No deal terms, merger, or special situation event is present; this is a routine administrative step related to the SPAC's unit structure. What to watch: future business combination announcement.
